learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to share things equally among our friends, which is the magic of division!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If you have 10 toffees and 2 friends, you can give one to each friend until the toffees are over. Both friends will get exactly 5 toffees!
Sometimes, when we share things equally, we might have one or two pieces left that cannot be shared. We call these the leftovers!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Candy Sharer
fun_activity.instructions: Take 12 small rajma seeds (beans). Try sharing them equally between 3 empty bowls. How many seeds are in each bowl?

quick_recap: ⭐ Sharing equally means everyone gets the exact same amount.
⭐ Grouping objects helps us understand division in a fun way!
